programme_role: Phase-X capstone synthesis; no new ecological world, transformation, observation process, assay channel or outcome is introduced
scientific_question: What is the coarsest exact representation of occurrence-compatible W1 BAM worlds that preserves a declared future target, and how does that target quotient relate to the complete current BAM-state partition?

partitions.parameter_world: singleton partition of W1 same-G variants
partitions.current_state: equivalence by complete current A/B/M/tau state
partitions.exact_future_map: equivalence by transformation-specific exact counterfactual G_cf
partitions.joint_exact_suite: equivalence by the tuple of all three exact future maps
partitions.joint_decision_suite: equivalence by the tuple of all three binary future decisions

refinement_convention: P refines Q iff every P block is contained in one Q block; P therefore retains at least as much distinction as Q
required_invariants: each exact_future_map partition refines its binary_decision partition
descriptive_endpoints: current_state versus each binary_decision relation: equal / current_state_refines / decision_refines / incomparable
fraction of fibers where complete current state is sufficient for each future target
fraction of fibers where future decision distinguishes dormant aliases inside one current-state class
worked examples for both over-detailed current state and under-detailed current state

interpretation.target_sufficient_quotient: the equivalence classes induced by the declared target; identifying a class is sufficient for that target even if parameter-world identity remains unresolved
interpretation.current_state_over_detailed: current_state strictly refines target partition, so some current-state distinctions are irrelevant to the target
interpretation.current_state_under_detailed: current_state does not refine target partition, so at least one current-state alias class contains multiple future target values
interpretation.incomparable: both unnecessary current-state distinctions and dormant target-relevant aliases occur in the same fiber

claim_boundary: Partition identities are elementary finite-set mathematics and are not claimed as new mathematics.
This phase is a synthesis of already frozen W1 results, not a fresh independent validation.
Block-count compression is not statistical dimension reduction and does not assign probabilities.
No claim is made that one quotient is sufficient for undeclared future targets.
The purpose is to define the exact inferential object to carry into external empirical validation.
stop_rule: After Phase X, do not add further synthetic BAM worlds or transformations to improve the quotient pattern; the next scientific validation must use an independently fixed external ecological system or transformation contract.
